approvalSource: User request: read back live prices, rebalance the full active catalog, and add a 20% market-price margin

scope.products: all active Shopify products and every live variant
scope.anchor: first governed live variant sell price; persisted per variant to prevent compounding
scope.combination: final target is the maximum of the approved cost-band target, the market-anchor target, and the price floor
scope.variantDifferences: calculate each variant independently and preserve option and quantity differences
scope.compareAtPrices: preserve only valid existing compare-at prices above the final target; clear invalid values; never invent compare-at prices
scope.missingAnchorData: capture the first live sell price only during dry-run or apply; verification fails if an anchor is missing
scope.status: do not change product status or sales-channel inclusion
